title: Ensure default repository access is restricted
description: Blanket grants are the quietest way for access to spread: nobody requests them, nobody reviews them, and they apply to accounts created long after the decision was made. Access should be granted deliberately, to named people or groups.
remediation: A permission every licensed user holds comes from one of two places: the project's default permission at Project settings -> Project permissions ("Default permissions"), or a grant to a group that holds everyone — typically stash-users or an all-staff directory group — at Project settings -> Project permissions or Repository settings -> Repository permissions. Reduce either to Read, or remove it, and grant Write and Admin to specific groups instead. To remove anonymous access, uncheck "Public access" at Repository settings -> Repository details and at Project settings -> Project details. For instances that intentionally publish code, set allowPublicRepositories: true in bitbucket-bench's config.
fixSummary: Reduce the default permission at Project settings -> Project permissions to Read.
